def build_agent(sandbox):
    # Return the cart body (already initialized by the environment)
    return sandbox.get_cart_body()

# Global variables to track previous sensor values
previous_theta = 0.0
previous_omega = 0.0

def agent_action(sandbox, cart, step_count):
    global previous_theta, previous_omega

    # Normalize angle to [-π, π]
    theta = normalize_angle(sandbox.get_pole_angle())
    omega = sandbox.get_pole_angular_velocity()
    
    # Low-pass filter to mitigate sensor delay
    theta_filtered = (theta + previous_theta) / 2
    omega_filtered = (omega + previous_omega) / 2
    
    # Update previous sensor values
    previous_theta = theta
    previous_omega = omega
    
    # Target position (center of the track)
    target_x = sandbox.TRACK_CENTER_X
    x, v = sandbox.get_cart_position(), sandbox.get_cart_velocity()

    # Tuned control gains for the new environment
    k_theta = -3.0    # Angle control gain
    k_omega = -0.8    # Angular velocity control gain
    k_x = -0.05       # Position control gain
    k_v = -0.15       # Velocity control gain
    k_limit = 0.5     # Track limit enforcement gain

    # Compute control force
    force = k_theta * theta_filtered + k_omega * omega_filtered + k_x * (x - target_x) + k_v * v

    # Track limit enforcement: apply a corrective force when cart approaches the edge
    distance_from_center = abs(x - target_x)
    if distance_from_center > (sandbox.SAFE_HALF_RANGE - 0.1):
        # Apply a force to bring the cart back toward the center
        force += k_limit * (target_x - x)

    # Apply the force, clamped to the actuator limit
    lim = 4.0  # Maximum allowed force in Newtons
    sandbox.apply_cart_force(max(-lim, min(lim, force)))
